rows.source: Measure
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.translation: Bar og measure betyder begge takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which beat usually feels strongest?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat 4
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 3
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.translation: Slag 1 er første slag i hver takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, half and quarter notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title

rows.source: Note values
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.translation: Nodens form viser, hvor længe den varer. I en takt på fire slag varer en helnode alle fire slag, en halvnode to og en fjerdedelsnode ét.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.translation: Hvor mange slag varer en halvnode?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.translation: To halvnoder fylder en takt på fire slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hvor mange fjerdedelsnoder fylder en takt på fire slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.translation: En fjerdedelsnode varer ét slag, så fire fylder takten.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which lasts longest?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.translation: En helnode varer fire slag, en halvnode to, en fjerdedelsnode ét.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Mix them
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: En takt kan blande værdier, hvis de går op. En halvnode plus to fjerdedele fylder fire slag: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Eighth and sixteenth notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: En ottendedelsnode varer et halvt slag, så der er to pr. slag. Tæl 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og med og mellem slagene.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.translation: En ottendedelsnode varer et halvt slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: En sekstendedelsnode varer en fjerdedel af et slag, så der er fire pr. slag. Tæl 1 e og a, 2 e og a.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Hvor mange sekstendedele svarer til én fjerdedelsnode?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: En fjerdedelsnode er ét slag, og der er fire sekstendedele på et slag.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Hvor mange ottendedele fylder en takt på fire slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: To pr. slag, fire slag: otte ottendedele.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Dots and rests
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title

rows.source: Dotted notes
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Et punkt efter en node tilføjer halvdelen af dens værdi. En halvnode varer to slag, så en punkteret halvnode varer tre. En punkteret fjerdedel varer halvandet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Halvdelen af to er én, så punktet tilføjer ét slag: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rests
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: En pause er målt stilhed. Hver nodeværdi har en tilsvarende pause: en fjerdedelspause varer ét slag, en halvpause to. Tæl videre gennem dem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: En fjerdedel er ét slag; punktet tilføjer halvdelen af det.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: En takt på fire slag har en halvnode og en fjerdedel. Hvad fylder hullet?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole rest
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, så ét slag er tilbage: en fjerdedelspause.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Time signatures
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title

rows.source: Reading a time signature
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: De to tal over hinanden i starten af et stykke er taktangivelsen. Det øverste tæller slag pr. takt. Det nederste viser, hvilken node der får ét slag: 4 betyder en fjerdedelsnode.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Hvor mange fjerdedelsslag er der i en takt i 4/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Øverste 4 betyder fire slag; nederste 4 gør hvert slag til en fjerdedelsnode.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 3/4 time
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: I 3/4 har hver takt tre fjerdedelsslag. Tæl 1, 2, 3 med vægten på 1. Det er valsens vuggen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: Hvilken taktart går en vals normalt i?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A waltz counts in threes: 1, 2, 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 6/8 time
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: I 6/8 har hver takt seks ottendedele i to grupper på tre. Det føles som to store slag, hver delt i tre: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How is 6/8 usually felt?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Six equal beats
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: To slag, hver delt i tre
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Tre slag, hver delt i to
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Ottendedelene grupperes 1 2 3, 4 5 6, så du mærker to stærke pulsslag pr. takt.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Hvilken enkelt node fylder en hel takt i 3/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A dotted half note
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Tre slag: en halvnode (2) plus dens punkt (1).
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rhythm challenge
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · title

rows.source: Count it, then tap it
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Nodeværdier, punkter, pauser og taktarter sammen. Tæl højt, mens du banker; stemmen holder hænderne på sporet.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.translation: Hvor mange slag varer en helnode i 4/4?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hvor mange sekstendedele er der på ét slag?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.translation: Hvad tilføjer et punkt til en node?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice its value
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Half its value
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: En takt i 3/4 har en fjerdedelsnode og en fjerdedelspause. Hvad mangler?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Nothing
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 har tre slag; 1 + 1 = 2, så ét slag mangler.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Hvor mange ottendedele er der i en takt i 6/8?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · challenge thy-4-6 “Rhythm challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Major scales and keys
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · title

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Opskriften med hel- og halvtonetrin, fire durtonearter og deres faste fortegn.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 “Major scales and keys” · unit summary

rows.source: A scale
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: En skala er toner, der stiger i rækkefølge fra en hjemmetone til samme tone en oktav oppe. C-dur bruger kun hvide tangenter: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hvor mange forskellige bogstaver er der i en durskala?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Syv bogstaver, så vender det første tilbage en oktav højere.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Går denne skala op eller ned?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Where the half steps fall
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: I C-dur er de fleste naboer et heltonetrin fra hinanden. Kun E til F og B til C er halvtonetrin. Den ujævne afstand giver skalaen sin lyd.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Hvilke trin er halvtonetrin i C-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: C til D og F til G
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: E til F og B til C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: D til E og A til B
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: E og F samt B og C har ingen sort tangent imellem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Hjemmetonen, kaldet tonika, giver skalaen navn.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Spil eller syng C-dur-skalaen op fra det midterste C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-1 “The C major scale” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The major scale recipe
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · title

rows.source: Whole, whole, half
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Alle durskalaer følger én trinopskrift: hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv. Start på en vilkårlig tone, følg den, og du bygger en durskala.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Hvad er durskalaens opskrift? (W = hel, H = halv)
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Giv skalaens toner numrene 1 til 8. Hvor er halvtonetrinene?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, så halv fra 3 til 4; hel, hel, hel, så halv fra 7 til 8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is this a major scale?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Fra G lander et heltonetrin op på...
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: G til A springer én tangent over, G♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Spil eller syng de første fire toner i D-dur: hel, hel, halv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-2 “The major scale recipe” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Building G major
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Start på G, og følg opskriften: G, A, B, C, D, E, så et heltonetrin til F♯ og et halvtonetrin hjem til G. G-dur har ét kryds: F♯.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Hvorfor kræver G-dur F♯ i stedet for F?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.translation: F er for dyb at synge
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sharps sound brighter
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-3 “G major” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F is only a half step

rows.source: Key signatures
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · title

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: I stedet for at skrive F♯ hver gang sætter musik i G-dur ét kryds ved hver linjes start. Det er de faste fortegn: de angiver toner, som altid har kryds eller b.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Krydser kommer altid i samme rækkefølge: F♯, C♯, G♯ og så videre. Sidste kryds er et halvtonetrin under toneartens navn. Ét kryds, F♯: G-dur.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 5 · lesson thy-5-5 “Key signatures” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: De faste fortegn har to krydser, F♯ og C♯. Hvilken durtoneart er det?

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Et intervals tal kommer af at tælle bogstavnavne med begge ender. C op til E tæller C, D, E: tre bogstaver, så det er en terts.

rows.source: Thirds by size
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · title

rows.source: Count half steps for size
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: To intervaller med samme tal kan have forskellig størrelse. Tæl halvtonetrin for et præcist mål. C op til E er fire; C op til E♭ er tre.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Hvor mange halvtonetrin fra D op til F?

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-2 “Thirds by size” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: En terts på fire halvtonetrin er en stor terts, som C til E. En terts på tre er en lille terts, som C til E♭ eller A til C.

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Unisoner, kvarter, kvinter og oktaver kaldes rene. En ren kvart spænder over fem halvtonetrin, en ren kvint over syv og en oktav over tolv.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 6 · lesson thy-6-3 “Perfect intervals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?

rows.translation: De fleste kvinter på hvide tangenter er rene, men B op til F spænder kun over seks halvtonetrin. Det kaldes en formindsket kvint. Tæl halvtonetrin ved tvivl.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 “Chords” · title

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.

rows.source: Building a triad
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · title

rows.source: Stacking thirds
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: En treklang er tre toner stablet i tertser. Start på en tone, spring et bogstav over, tag det næste, og spring igen. C, spring D over, E, spring F over, G: C E G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Hvilke toner danner en treklang bygget på G?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, spring A over, B, spring C over, D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Tonen, en treklang bygges på, er grundtonen. Den midterste tone er tertsen, og den øverste er kvinten, opkaldt efter deres afstand over grundtonen.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone er grundtonen i treklangen F A C?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F er den nederste tone, treklangen bygges på.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone er kvinten i treklangen D F A?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: D op til A er en kvint: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Hvilken treklang bygges på E med kun hvide tangenter?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, spring F over, G, spring A over, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Spil eller syng C-treklangen én tone ad gangen: C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-1 “Building a triad” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Major and minor triads
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · title

rows.source: Major triads
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: En durtreklang har en stor terts nederst, fire halvtonetrin, og så en lille terts øverst. C E G er dur. Det er F A C og G B D også.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Byt om på tertserne, så får du mol: lille terts nederst, så stor terts. Sænk midtertonen i C-dur, så får du C-mol: C E♭ G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes spell D minor?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: D til F er en lille terts; F til A er en stor terts.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which notes spell E major?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: E til G♯ er en stor terts; G♯ til B er en lille terts.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Er A C E dur eller mol?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: A til C er en lille terts, tre halvtonetrin.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Spil eller syng A-mol én tone ad gangen: A, C, E.

rows.source: Chords from a scale
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Byg en treklang på hver skalatone med kun skalaens toner, så får du toneartens akkordfamilie. C-dur har syv, én pr. tone.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Treklangen på B er anderledes: B D F. Begge tertser er små, så det er en formindsket treklang. Den lyder spændt og vil videre.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-3 “The chords of a key” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Numbering chords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Musikere nummererer toneartens akkorder med romertal: I til akkorden på tone 1 op til vii på tone 7. Store bogstaver betyder dur, små mol og ° formindsket.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The major key pattern
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Alle durtonearter følger ét mønster: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. I C-dur er det C, D-mol, E-mol, F, G, A-mol og B formindsket.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Sjette tone er A, og vi med små bogstaver betyder mol.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Tæl op fra G: G, A, B, C, D. Femte tone er D, og V er dur.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 “Progressions” · title

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Sådan bevæger akkorder sig i sange: I–IV–V, poprunden, ii–V–I, 12-takters blues og kadencer.

rows.source: I, IV and V
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · title

rows.source: Three chords
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Utallige folk-, rock- og countrysange bruger kun tre akkorder: I, IV og V. I C-dur er det C, F og G. Sammen rummer de alle skalaens toner.

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I føles som hjemme. IV går væk. V bygger spænding, der trækker tilbage til I. Den tur ud og hjem former et væld af sange.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord trækker stærkest tilbage til I?

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V bygger spænding, der opløses til I.

rows.source: The pop progression
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · title

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Denne runde med fire akkorder ligger under et væld af popsange. I C-dur er den C, G, A-mol, F. Molakkorden vi giver lidt skygge, før IV løfter tilbage mod hjem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same chords, new start
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Start samme runde på vi, så får du vi–IV–I–V: A-mol, F, C, G. Akkorderne er de samme, men mol i starten får det til at lyde alvorligere.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er vi i F-dur?

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: sjette tone er D, og vi er mol.

rows.source: The jazz workhorse
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I er jazzens mest almindelige akkordfølge. I C-dur: D-mol, G, C. Hver grundtone falder en kvint til den næste, så skiftet føles som at komme hjem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Add sevenths
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Jazzmusikere tilføjer som regel septimer: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. De ekstra toner gør hvert skift endnu glattere. Grundtonerne og turen hjem er uændrede.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Twelve bars
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12-takters blues er en akkordform på tolv takter bag utallige blues-, rock- og jazzmelodier. Den bruger I, IV og V, ofte alle som dominantseptimakkorder for et bluespræg.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Is this the 12-bar blues?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: The plan
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Fire takter I. To IV, to I. Én V, én IV, to I. Så gentages det. I A: A7 fire gange, D7 to gange, A7 to gange, E7, D7, A7 to gange.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Hvor mange takter I åbner en 12-takters blues?

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Fire takter I, så kommer IV i takt 5.

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Takt 9 er den ene takt V, før IV i takt 10.

rows.source: Cadences
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · title

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: En kadence er akkordskiftet, der slutter en frase, som tegnsætning. V til I er stærkest, et punktum. Det kaldes en autentisk kadence.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Other endings
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV til I er en plagal kadence, det bløde amen sidst i mange salmer. At stoppe på V er en halvkadence, som et komma. V til vi er skuffende: du venter hjem, men overraskes.

rows.context: Rhythm course · title

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Mærk pulsen, tæl, og bank i takt
rows.context: Rhythm course · course subtitle

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Find pulsen, tæl til fire, og bank i takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 “The beat” · unit summary

rows.source: Find the pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · title

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Slaget er den jævne puls, du vipper foden til. Det løber eller slæber aldrig, som skridt på en rolig gåtur. Alle rytmer ligger oven på det.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap with the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Hold fingerspidsen lige over skærmen, og tryk ved hvert klik. Lad den springe fra glasset som en trommestik. Sigt efter at lande med klikket, ikke efter.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How does a beat feel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady and even
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Fast, then slow
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Loud, then quiet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Pulsen holder samme afstand mellem slagene som et tikkende ur.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count to four
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title

rows.source: Count out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Det meste musik grupperer slag i fire. Tæl 1, 2, 3, 4 højt med klikket, og start igen ved 1. At sige tallene hjælper hænderne med at holde takten.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bars and beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: En takt er en gruppe slag. Her har hver takt fire slag, skrevet 4/4. Slag 1 starter hver takt, så læg lidt vægt på det, når du tæller.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Det kraftige klik er slag 1. Hvor mange slag er der pr. takt?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which beat starts every bar?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Tællingen starter igen ved 1 i begyndelsen af hver takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Quarter notes and longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: En node på ét slag er en fjerdedelsnode. Fire fylder en takt i 4/4, så at trykke på hvert slag er at trykke fjerdedele.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count more than you tap
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Tryk nu kun på 1 og 3. Hvert tryk er en halvnode, to slag lang. Tæl stadig alle fire; de oversprungne slag sker stadig.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Du trykker på 1 og 3. Hvad sker der på 2 og 4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You keep counting
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The music stops
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You tap twice as fast
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Pulsen stopper aldrig. Du tæller gennem slagene uden tryk.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note: just beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: En helnode varer alle fire slag. Tryk én gang på 1, og tæl 2, 3, 4 stille, så næste 1 lander i tide.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo er, hvor hurtigt pulsen går, målt i slag pr. minut eller bpm. Ved 60 bpm kommer slaget én gang pr. sekund som et ur.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Hvor ofte kommer slaget ved 60 bpm?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once every two seconds
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 slag på 60 sekunder er ét slag hvert sekund.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Smaller as it speeds up
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Hurtigere tempi kræver mindre indsats, ikke mere. Hold hånden løs, og tryk fra knoen, ikke håndled eller skulder.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempoet stiger. Hvad skal dine tryk gøre?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Get bigger and harder
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stay small and light
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Små, afslappede bevægelser er hurtigere og lettere at holde jævne.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Steady hands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring blander slag, takter, længere noder og tempo. Tæl højt hele vejen, og hold trykkene små og afslappede.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Hvilken node varer en hel takt i 4/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: En helnode varer fire slag, hele takten i 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What does 90 bpm mean?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 90 beats every minute
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 90 bars every minute
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 90 taps in each bar
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm tæller slag pr. minut, så 90 bpm er halvandet slag hvert sekund.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Del hvert slag i to, og tæl “og”.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 “Eighth notes” · unit summary

rows.source: Two taps per beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · title

rows.source: Split the beat in two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: En ottendedelsnode varer et halvt slag, så der er to pr. slag. Otte fylder en takt i 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Sig tallet på hvert slag og “og” præcis midt imellem: 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Tryk på hvert ord.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: En ottendedel er et halvt slag, så to fylder hvert slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: De kraftige klik er slagene. Hvor mange slag hørte du?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Quarters and eighths
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · title

rows.source: Mix long and short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Nu får nogle slag ét tryk og andre to. Bliv ved med at sige hvert “og”, også dem uden tryk.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Slag 1 har to tryk, 1 og. Slag 2, 3 og 4 får ét tryk hver.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Read the counts
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · title

rows.source: Every tap has a name
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: I ottendedele lander hvert tryk på et tal eller et “og”. Sig tællingen højt én gang, før du trykker et nyt mønster.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which counts match this pattern?
rows.translation: Hvilke tællinger passer til dette mønster?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 1, 2 and, 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2, 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Slag 1 og 3 har to tryk hver; slag 2 og 4 har ét.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 2 and 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2, 3, 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 2, 3 and 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Slag 1 har ét tryk, slag 2 og 3 har to, og slag 4 har ét.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Even eighths
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · title

rows.source: Make both halves equal
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: “Og” skal lande præcis midt mellem slagene. Lyder ottendedelene som galop, så sænk tempoet, og sig tællingen, mens du trykker.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Dine ottendedele lyder ujævne. Hvad hjælper mest?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap harder on each beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.translation: Øg tempoet, til det bliver jævnt
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Lavere tempo giver tid til at lægge hvert “og” i midten. Tællingen holder det dér.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep your fingertip close
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Hold fingeren lige over glasset mellem trykkene. En kort, let bevægelse er lettere at holde jævn ved hurtigere tempi.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Eighth-note check
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring blander fjerdedele og ottendedele. Sig hvert mønsters tælling én gang, og tryk så med hvert “og” præcis i midten.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rests and syncopation
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · title

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Giv bevidst plads, og tryk så mellem slagene.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · unit summary

rows.source: Rests are counted
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · title

rows.source: A rest is counted silence
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: En pause er stilhed med en fast længde. Du tæller stadig; du trykker bare ikke. En fjerdedelspause varer ét slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.translation: Hvad gør du i en pause?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Skip to the next note
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap softly
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count it silently
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: En pause tager tid ligesom en tone. At tælle den holder dig på plads.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rest on beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Det sværeste er at lade slag 1 være tomt. Nik på 1, så du mærker det uden tryk, og kom så ind på 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap the and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · title

rows.source: Rest, then tap the and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: En ottendedelspause varer et halvt slag. Tæl 1 og 2 og, hold pause på 2, og tryk i stedet på dets “og”. Det føles som et lille skub ind i slag 3.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where is the second tap?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On beat 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the "and" of 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On beat 3
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Det ligger midt mellem slag 2 og 3, på “og” efter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Syncopation
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · title

rows.source: Syncopation: off the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Synkopering lægger en stærk tone mellem slagene, hvor øret ikke venter den. Det får rytmen til at læne sig frem.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count every eighth
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Dette mønster lander på 1, “og” efter 2 og 4. Tæl 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og, og tryk kun de tre steder.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Tæl klikkene fra 1 til 8. Hvor falder de kraftige?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 4 and 7
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 5
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: What makes a rhythm syncopated?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Notes only on beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strong notes between the beats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Synkopering flytter vægten væk fra slaget til et “og” eller et svagt slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Offbeats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · title

rows.source: Tap only the ands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Offbeat er “og” mellem slagene. Nik på tallene, og tryk kun på og, som de korte akkorder fra en reggaeguitar.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Første klik er slag 1. Ligger de kraftige klik på tallene eller og-slagene?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the numbers
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the ands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Where do offbeats land?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Between the beats, on the "and"
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On every beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Offbeat-slag falder midt mellem slagene, på hvert “og”.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Space and push
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring blander pauser, “og” alene, synkopering og offbeat. Tæl hver ottendedel højt, også når du ikke trykker.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these is syncopated?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, the "and" of 2, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: At trykke på “og” efter 2 og springe 3 over flytter vægten væk fra slaget.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 3 and 6
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ties and dots
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · title

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Hold toner hen over slaget med bindebuer og punkterede rytmer.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · unit summary

rows.source: Ties
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · title

rows.source: A tie joins two notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: En bindebue er en buet linje mellem to noder. Du spiller den første og holder gennem den anden, så den bundne node ikke får et nyt tryk.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Slag 2 er bundet til slag 3. Hvad gør du på 3?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep holding, no new tap
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap again
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop the sound and wait
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: En bindebue forlænger én tone. Du tæller 3, men tonen fra slag 2 klinger videre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Tie across the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Bind “og” efter 2 ind i slag 3. Tryk på “og”, og lad så slag 3 passere, mens tonen klinger. Det er synkopering skrevet på en anden måde.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What a dot does
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · title

rows.source: A dot adds half
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Et punkt efter en node tilføjer halvdelen af dens længde. En halvnode varer to slag, så en punkteret halvnode varer tre. Tryk på 1, tæl 2 og 3, tryk på 4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: En fjerdedelsnode varer ét slag. Hvor længe varer en punkteret fjerdedel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Halvdelen af ét slag er et halvt slag. Læg det til, så får du halvandet.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The dotted quarter
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: En punkteret fjerdedel varer halvandet slag, så næste tone lander på et “og”. Tæl 1 og 2 og: tryk på 1, så på “og” efter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Du trykkede dette mønster med pause i del 3. Hvad ændrer et punkt?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The first note rings longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The taps move
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tempo slows
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Trykkene lander de samme steder. Kun første tones længde ændres.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long, short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · title

rows.source: Dotted quarter, then eighth
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: En punkteret fjerdedel plus en ottendedel fylder to slag: lang, kort. Tæl 1 og 2 og; tryk på 1 og “og” efter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Hvor længe varer en punkteret fjerdedel og en ottendedel tilsammen?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Three beats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Halvandet plus en halv er to.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Hvad varer lige så længe som en punkteret fjerdedel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.translation: En fjerdedel bundet til en ottendedel
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two eighth notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Bindebuen tilføjer et halvt slag til fjerdedelen, ligesom punktet.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Held notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring blander bindebuer og punkter. Tæl hver ottendedel højt; en holdt tone tager stadig sin fulde tid.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Hvor længe varer en punkteret halvnode?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: En halvnode er to slag; punktet tilføjer ét mere.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: En bindebue forbinder to noder. Hvor mange gange trykker du?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Du trykker første tone og holder gennem den anden.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Triplets and swing
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · title

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Del slaget i tre, og lad så ottendedelene swinge.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · unit summary

rows.source: Three to a beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · title

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: En triol lægger tre lige toner på ét slag. Tæl 1-tri-ol, 2-tri-ol med lige lange stavelser.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hvor mange trioltoner er der på ét slag?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Trioler deler hvert slag i tre lige dele.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Er klikkene i grupper på to eller tre?
