rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Groups of two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Groups of three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Switch between two and three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Ottendedele deler slaget i to; trioler deler det i tre. Selve slaget bliver. Kun inddelingen ændres.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triplets
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Tre stavelser pr. slag betyder tre toner pr. slag: trioler.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Swing feel
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · title

rows.source: Swing: long, short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: I swing bliver hvert ottendedelspar lang-kort. “Og” kommer senere, på triolens sidste del. Tænk du-ba, du-ba.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Skip the middle triplet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Tæl 1-tri-ol, og tryk kun på “1” og “ol”. Hullet i midten er swinget.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Exactly halfway
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right after the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Late, on the last triplet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Swing forsinker “og” til sidste trioltone og giver lang-kort-svinget.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The ride pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · title

rows.source: The jazz ride pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Jazztrommeslagere spiller dette på ridebækkenet: 1, 2, et swingende “og”, 3, 4, et swingende “og”. Det lyder som ding, ding-a ding.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the next beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Et swingende “og” venter til slagets sidste trioltone.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight or swung
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Lige ottendedele deler slaget jævnt; swingende ottendedele går lang-kort. Tryk først det ene, så det andet, og mærk forskellen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Threes and swing
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring blander trioler, lige ottendedele og swing. Hold pulsen jævn, mens inddelingen skifter.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Hvad gør swing hvert ottendedelspar til?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Første ottendedel forlænges, og “og” kommer sent.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Other meters
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · title

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Vals i tre, march i to, rock i 6/8 og placering af betoning.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · unit summary

rows.source: Waltz time: 3/4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · title

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: I 3/4 har hver takt tre slag: EN, to, tre. Det er vals. Tæl 1, 2, 3, og læg vægt på 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Long, short in three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: En halvnode fylder to af de tre slag. Tryk på 1, tæl 2, tryk på 3. Det føles som valsens store og lille skridt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.translation: Hvor mange slag er der i en takt i 3/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Taktangivelsens øverste tal fortæller, hvor mange slag der er i hver takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: March time: 2/4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · title

rows.source: Two beats to a bar
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 har to slag pr. takt: EN, to, som marcherende fødder. Takterne går hurtigt, så slag 1 vender ofte tilbage.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.translation: Hvilken taktart føles som en march?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: To slag pr. takt passer til venstre, højre, venstre, højre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Six-eight time
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · title

rows.source: Six eighths, two groups
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: I 6/8 har hver takt seks ottendedele i to grupper på tre: EN to tre FIRE fem seks. Det føles som to store, vuggende slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How does 6/8 usually feel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Six equal beats, no pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: De seks ottendedele falder i to grupper på tre, så du mærker to store slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long, short in 6/8
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Et populært 6/8-mønster går lang-kort, lang-kort: tryk på 1, 3, 4 og 6. Det vugger som en vuggevise eller sømandssang.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Seks klik pr. takt. Hvilken taktart er dette?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: 3/4: three groups of two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 6/8: two groups of three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Accents
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · title

rows.source: Accents shape a rhythm
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: En betoning er en tone spillet kraftigere end dem omkring den. Flyt betoningen, så ændres fornemmelsen, selv om alle toner er uændrede.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap only the accents
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Tæl alle otte ottendedele, og tryk kun betoningerne: 1, “og” efter 2 og 4. Dette 3-3-2-mønster driver meget pop og latinmusik.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is an accent?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A note played longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note left out
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note played stronger
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Betoning handler om vægt, ikke længde. Tonen spilles bare kraftigere.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The backbeat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rock, pop og soul betoner slag 2 og 4. Det er backbeatet. Tæl alle fire, og tryk kun på 2 og 4 som en lilletromme.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Første klik er slag 1. Hvor ligger de kraftige klik?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: On 1 and 3
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On 2 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On every click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every meter
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · title

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Denne udfordring skifter mellem taktarter og betoninger. Tæl én takt stille før hver trykøvelse for at finde slag 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Seks ottendedele pr. takt, mærket i to grupper på tre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Singing
rows.context: Singing course · title

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Find din stemme, og syng rent
rows.context: Singing course · course subtitle

rows.source: Finding your voice
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Stå rankt, træk vejret dybt, hold din første jævne tone, og syng en sang.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · unit summary

rows.source: Stand and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · title

rows.source: Stand tall, stay loose
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stå med fødderne i hoftebredde og bløde knæ. Lad skuldrene falde og hovedet løfte sig, som om en snor trækker det op. Hold kæben løs.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Breathe low
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Hvil en hånd på maven, og ånd langsomt ind. Maven og de nederste ribben udvider sig, mens skuldrene er stille. Det dybe åndedræt driver stemmen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.translation: Hvad skal bevæge sig, når du ånder ind for at synge?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your shoulders
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your belly and lower ribs
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Et dybt åndedræt udvider ribben og mave. Løftede skuldre spænder nakke og hals.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Any octave counts
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre lytter efter tonenavnet, så både et dybt og et højt C tæller. Vælg den oktav, der føles let, aldrig anstrengt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Træk vejret dybt, og syng C på “ah” i en behagelig oktav. Hold tonen jævn.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Igen: stå rankt, træk vejret dybt, og lad tonen klinge.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold one note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · title

rows.source: Sustain with even air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: At holde en tone er at bevare én jævn tonehøjde. Lad luften slippe langsomt og jævnt ud, som når du dugger et spejl uden stop.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Syng C på “ah”, og hold den jævn, til den falder på plads.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Tonen vakler og svinder. Hvad hjælper mest?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Singing louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tightening your throat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow, even air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Jævn luft giver en jævn tone. Ekstra styrke og spænding gør den sværere at styre.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Nu E. Samme dybe åndedræt, samme lette “ah”.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open vowel, open throat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Syng “ah” med sænket kæbe og tungespidsen bag de nederste tænder. Lyden flyder ud i stedet for at blive klemt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: G denne gang. Sænk kæben, og hold “ah” åbent.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Match a pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · title

rows.source: Hear it, then sing it
rows.translation: Hør den, og syng den så
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: At matche tonehøjde betyder at synge den tone, du hører. Lyt, forestil dig tonen et øjeblik, syng så svagt, og justér, til den falder på plads.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Syng E svagt, og justér, til tonen falder på plads.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Flat and sharp
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: For lavt er under måltonen; for højt er over. Er du for lav, så løft lidt. Er du for høj, så sænk roligt. Små bevægelser virker bedst.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre siger, du er for lav. Hvad gør du?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sing a little higher
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing a little lower
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: For lavt betyder under tonen, så hæv tonehøjden lidt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: To toner denne gang: D, så G. Træk vejret imellem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Warm up gently
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · title

rows.source: Hum to warm up
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: At nynne med lukkede læber er blid opvarmning. Mærk en let summen på læber og næse. Hold det svagt og let.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Nyn C, E og G, én ad gangen. Hold det let.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Lip trills
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Luk læberne løst, og pust, så de vibrerer som en motorbåd. Tilføj så stemmen. Det holder halsen afslappet, mens stemmen vågner.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Lav læbetrille på G, E, så C. Stopper læberne, så tryk let på kinderne.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: En tone føles spændt eller kradsende. Hvad gør du?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Push harder through it
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Clear your throat hard
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Anstrengelse er et signal om at lette. Hvil, drik lidt vand, og vend tilbage lettere.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Easy hum
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Stå rankt, træk vejret dybt, og start hver tone blødt. Hvil mellem trinene, hvis stemmen føles træt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, så G. Hør hver tone, før du synger den.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What does sharp mean?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Under the target pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Louder than the note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the target pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
rows.translation: For højt er over måltonen; for lavt er under.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Syng D svagt, og justér, til tonen falder på plads.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Up and home
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb bruger tre toner: E, D og C, hver et trin fra den næste. Syng, hvor det føles let; Timbre hører den rigtige tone i alle oktaver.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: tre trin ned mod hjem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pitch matching
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · title

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Hør en tone, syng den tilbage, og bevæg dig i små trin.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · unit summary

rows.source: Hear it first
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · title

rows.source: Imagine before you sing
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Hør tonen i hovedet et øjeblik, før du synger. Pausen lader stemmen sigte mod tonehøjden i stedet for at lede.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør D i hovedet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør F i hovedet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Første forsøg er for lavt. Hvad nu?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lift a little and hold
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Give up on that note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Jump up a lot
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Små ændringer finder tonen hurtigst. Løft blidt, og lad den falde på plads.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør A i hovedet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Tre toner på række: D, F, A.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Unison and repeats
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · title

rows.source: Unison: the same note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unison betyder to lyde på præcis samme tonehøjde. Matcher de, smelter de sammen; er de lidt ved siden af, hører du svævninger.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Syng E, og hold tonen ren.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Repeat a note cleanly
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Syng samme tone to gange ved at stoppe luften et øjeblik og starte igen på et blødt “da”. Glid ikke mellem dem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Syng E tre gange på “da” med et lille hul hver gang.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Same note, fresh start
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Steps and half steps
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · title

rows.source: A step is the next note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Et trin går til næste tone i skalaen, op eller ned. Trin er de mindste og letteste bevægelser at synge rent.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Step up: C, D, E.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Et halvtonetrin er det mindste trin, som E til F uden en tone imellem. De fleste nabotoner i skalaen, som C og D, er et heltonetrin fra hinanden: to halvtonetrin.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, et halvtonetrin op til F og tilbage.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step by step
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Match and move
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · title

rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Hør først hver tone i hovedet, start blødt, og justér i små bevægelser. Giv gentagne toner en frisk start.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør G i hovedet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, et halvtonetrin op til C og tilbage.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which is a half step?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G to A
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: E til F har ingen tone imellem. C til D og G til A er heltonetrin.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Steps and repeats
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · challenge voc-2-4 “Match and move” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Scales
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 “Scales” · title

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 “Scales” · unit summary

rows.source: Solfege names the steps
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solmisation giver hvert skalatrin en stavelse: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do er hjemme, uanset hvor skalaen starter.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Syng do, re, mi på C, D, E.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Hvilken stavelse er hjemme, skalaens første trin?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do er første trin og den tone, skalaen vender tilbage til.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
rows.translation: Nu ned igen: mi, re, do.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-1 “Do, re, mi” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Do to sol
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · title

rows.source: Five steps: do to sol
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: de første fem trin bærer mange enkle melodier. Syng op og ned på ét åndedræt, hvis det føles let.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C op til G.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.translation: Mellem hvilke to trin er der et halvtonetrin?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do and re
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Fa and sol
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Mi and fa
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Mi til fa (E til F) er et halvtonetrin. De andre trin fra do til sol er heltonetrin.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Sol ned til do: G ned til C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Up five, down five
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-2 “Do to sol” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: All eight steps
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Durskalaen går fra do op til næste do: otte toner. Mi til fa og ti til do er halvtonetrin; alle andre er heltonetrin.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Do til do: C op til næste C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hvor ligger halvtonetrinene i en durskala?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do-re and sol-la
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Re-mi and la-ti
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa og ti-do er halvtonetrin. Det mønster giver durskalaen sin lyd.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Lighter at the top
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Tag et dybt åndedræt før start, så luften ikke slipper op nær toppen. Lad høje toner blive lettere, ikke kraftigere, og hold kæben løs.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Ned igen fra C til C. Hold hver dybere tone lys, så den ikke synker for lavt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Major scale, up and down
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-3 “The major scale” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Five-note patterns
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · title

rows.source: Patterns train your ear
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Korte mønstre som do-re-mi-re-do opbygger hurtigt præcision. Syng ét, start det så et trin højere, og lad skalaen guide dig.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which pattern did you hear?

rows.source: Up, then back down

rows.source: Down, then back up

rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Do op til sol og tilbage: C til G til C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Syng C-D-E-D-C, så samme form et trin højere. Hvad er den øverste tone nu?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Et trin højere bliver formen D, E, F, E, D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · lesson voc-3-4 “Five-note patterns” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Scale check
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · title

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Træk vejret dybt før hver skala, hold toppen let, og hold de dybere toner lyse på vej ned.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Hvor mange toner er der i en durskala fra do til do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: otte toner med do i begge ender.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight down

rows.context: Singing · Unit 3 · challenge voc-3-5 “Scale check” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Intervals you can sing
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · title

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Spring i tertser, kvinter og oktaver, og land rent.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 “Intervals you can sing” · unit summary

rows.source: Thirds
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · title

rows.source: Skip a step: the third
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Et interval er afstanden mellem to toner. Spring ét skalatrin over, så får du en terts, som do til mi. Hør mi i hovedet, før du forlader do.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Do til mi og tilbage: C, E, C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A step or a skip?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A step
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: A skip (a third)
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Another third: D, F, D.
rows.translation: En anden terts: D, F, D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which pair is a third?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C and E
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: C til E springer D over og spænder derfor over tre skalatoner: en terts.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Thirds up the scale
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-1 “Thirds” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Fifths
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · title

rows.source: Do to sol: the fifth
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Do til sol spænder over fem skalatoner, en kvint. Den lyder åben og stærk. Forestil dig trinene imellem, og spring så direkte til sol.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Do til sol og tilbage: C, G, C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Third or fifth?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: to tertser stablet bliver til en kvint.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Hvor mange skalatoner er der fra do til sol, med begge ender talt med?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: fem toner, så det er en kvint.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-2 “Fifths” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same name, eight notes up
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: En oktav springer fra do til næste do, otte skalatoner op. Tonerne deler navn og blander sig så godt, at de næsten lyder som én.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Octave or fifth?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Leap without reaching
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Træk vejret dybt før et oktavspring, og hold hagen vandret. Tænk den øverste tone som let og ubesværet, ikke et stræk opad.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, så G, så det høje C. Brug G som trædesten.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Hvorfor blander oktavens to toner sig så godt?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: They're the same pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.translation: Den øverste vibrerer dobbelt så hurtigt
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: They're always sung loudly
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Øverste tone vibrerer præcis dobbelt så hurtigt som nederste, så deres bølger flugter.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Leap and step down
rows.translation: Spring op, og gå trinvis ned
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · lesson voc-4-3 “The octave” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Leaps and landings
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · title

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Hør hvert spring i hovedet, før du synger. Land let på øverste tone, og gå så trinvis hjem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do, mi, sol, high do.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Højt do, sol, mi, do: ned igen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Hvad er intervallet fra do til næste do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A fifth
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A third
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Do til næste do spænder over otte skalatoner: en oktav.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 4 · challenge voc-4-4 “Leaps and landings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Fem ophavsretsfrie melodier, kun melodi, i roligt tempo.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 “Melodies” · unit summary

rows.source: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · title

rows.source: A tune you already know
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Denne traditionelle melodi springer op og går så trinvis hjem. Syng på “loo”, og giv hver gentaget tone en frisk start.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Åbningsspringet: C op til G, et trin til A, tilbage til G.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Midterfrasen: går den op eller ned?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Middle phrase
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-1 “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's famous tune
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Denne melodi fra Beethovens niende symfoni går næsten kun trinvis. Hold den glidende og jævn som at gå op og ned ad en trappe.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: De fem toner, melodien bruger: F op til C.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Første frase slutter med en punkteret node. Hvordan føles det?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two equal notes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Den punkterede tone holdes længere, så fører en kort tone ind i den sidste.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Start with a pickup
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Denne traditionelle skotske melodi starter med en optakt, en tone før første hele takt. Syng den let, og læg så vægt på næste tone.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Stigningen i tredje takt: F, A, C, op til D.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What is a pickup?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest at the end
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.translation: En tone før første hele takt
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: En optakt fører ind i slag 1 i første hele takt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-3 “Auld Lang Syne” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Denne amerikanske salmemelodi fra tidligt i 1800-tallet går i 3/4: tæl 1, 2, 3. Lange toner bliver ofte til et hurtigt par, så hold parret let.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Den hurtige vending: F, op til A, tilbage til F.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Hvor mange slag er der i hver takt af denne salme?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Den går i 3/4: tre slag pr. takt med vægten på 1.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A slow river song
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Denne amerikanske folkesang fra 1800-tallet går langsomt med store spring. Træk vejret i hver pause, og hør hvert spring, før du synger det.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Åbningsspringet: dybt G op til C. Alle oktaver tæller.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Det store spring: G op til højt C, så trinvis ned.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Hvor skal du trække vejret i denne sang?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: At the rests between phrases
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pauserne markerer fraseslutninger. Træk vejret dér, så hver linje har fuld støtte.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Traditional (19th century)
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · song voc-5-5 “Shenandoah” · arrangement · lyric credit (a name and year: usually keep as is)

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Fem melodier i træk, én frase af hver. Træk vejret i hver pause, og giv gentagne toner en frisk start.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Hvilken af disse sange går i 3/4?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace tæller 1, 2, 3 i hver takt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 5 · challenge voc-5-6 “Medley” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Control
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · title

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Hold toner jævne, form kraftigt og svagt, og varm godt op.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 “Control” · unit summary

rows.source: Hold it steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · title

rows.source: Steady air, steady pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Tonehøjden driver, når luften bag den ændres. Hold et dybt, jævnt åndedræt, og se tonen blive i centrum fra start til slut.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Hold G, og behold tonen i centrum.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Finish before you're empty
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Toner synker ofte for lavt, når luften slipper op. Stop lidt før du er tom, og tag så et nyt dybt åndedræt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Dine lange toner bliver for lave til sidst. Hvad hjælper?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.translation: Slut tonen tidligere, og træk vejret
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze out the last air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing the end louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Tonehøjden falder, når luften er ved at slippe op. En lidt tidligere slutning holder hele tonen ren.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long and steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Climbing long notes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-1 “Hold it steady” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Vibrato basics
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato er en blid, regelmæssig bølge i tonehøjden, cirka fem til syv gange pr. sekund. Det vokser ud af afslappet hals og jævnt åndedræt, ikke af rysten.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Shaking your jaw
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Pulsing your belly
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato opstår, når stemmen er fri og støttet. At tvinge det fra kæbe eller mave skaber vaklen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight tone first
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Lær at holde en lige, jævn tone, før du jagter vibrato. Når stemmen er afslappet og støttet, kommer vibrato ofte af sig selv.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Et lige, jævnt A. Ingen bølge, kun en klar linje.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Hvad er det bedste første mål for en ny sanger?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A wide, fast wobble
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A steady, straight tone
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: As much vibrato as possible
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: En jævn tone er grundlaget. Vibrato, der vokser ud af den, lyder naturligt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight and steady
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-2 “Vibrato basics” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Dynamics: loud and soft
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dynamik er, hvor kraftigt eller svagt du synger. Syng kraftigere med mere åndedrætsenergi, ikke ved at klemme halsen. Tonehøjden skal blive.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Syng E svagt, så kraftigere på samme tonehøjde.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Hvad kan ske med tonehøjden, når du synger kraftigere?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It can drift sharp
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It drops an octave
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Nothing ever changes
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Ekstra pres hæver ofte tonehøjden, og meget svage toner kan synke for lavt. Hold øje med tonen i begge tilfælde.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Swell and fade
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: En styrkebølge vokser fra svagt til kraftigere og tilbage på ét åndedræt. Start stille, voks blidt, og svind så, alt på samme tonehøjde.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Lad G vokse: svagt, kraftigere, svagt. Hold tonen i centrum.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Swell each note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Your warm-up routine
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · title

rows.source: Five minutes before you sing
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: En kort opvarmning starter stemmen blidt: træk vejret dybt, nyn, lav læbetrille, og syng en skala. Start midt i dit register, og hold det behageligt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Stemmen føles træt efter øvning. Hvad er bedst?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Push through another hour
rows.translation: At presse igennem endnu en time
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest it and sip water
rows.translation: At hvile den og drikke lidt vand
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Hvile hjælper en træt stemme. Varer hæshed ved i nogle uger, så kontakt en læge.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Control check
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · title

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Varm op først. Hold så hver tone jævn, form den svagt og kraftigt, og træk vejret, før luften slipper op.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is vibrato?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A regular wave in pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing slightly flat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A very loud note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato er en blid, jævn bølge omkring tonen nogle gange pr. sekund.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.translation: Hvad tilføjer du for at synge kraftigere?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Throat squeeze
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Breath energy
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Jaw tension
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Åndedrætsenergi giver større lyd uden anstrengelse.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Spil melodien, eller slå akkorderne an og syng
rows.context: Songs course · course subtitle

rows.source: First songs
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · title

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Seks kendte melodier, én tone ad gangen, på de øverste strenge. Langsomt tempo, store fremskridt.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 “First songs” · unit summary

rows.source: Edison's first recording
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: I 1877 fremsagde Thomas Edison dette rim for at teste sin nye fonograf. Melodien bruger C og D på streng 2, så løst E og G på bånd 3 på streng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: løs streng 1, så streng 2 på bånd 3 og 1 og tilbage.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D på bånd 3 på streng 2. Så løst E og G på bånd 3 på streng 1.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-mary “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A French folk tune
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Melodien blev først trykt i Frankrig i 1761, og Mozart skrev senere tolv variationer over den. Den springer op og går trinvis ned over streng 2 og 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Løst G, et spring op til D på bånd 3 på streng 2, løst E og tilbage til D.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Trinvis ned i par: C på bånd 1, løst B, A på bånd 2 på streng 3, løst G.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Hvilken anden sang bruger samme melodi?
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Jingle Bells
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The alphabet song
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Alfabetsangen og Mæ, mæ, lam låner begge denne franske melodi.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Opening phrase
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-twinkle “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Beethoven's Ninth
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven færdiggjorde sin niende symfoni i 1824, og melodien er nu EU's hymne. Her spiller du hele melodien, også midterstykket.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Starten: E E F G G F E D, ét trin ad gangen.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Two notes in one beat
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: I midterstykket deler E og F ét slag. Tæl en, to-og, tre, fire, og spil E på to og F på og.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Midten: hurtige E F-par på streng 1, så ned til løst G på streng 3.
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The middle section
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-ode-to-joy “Ode to Joy” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · title

rows.source: A tune that chases itself
rows.translation: En melodi, der jager sig selv
rows.context: Songs · Unit 1 · song song-frere-jacques “Frère Jacques” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
